answer: Each AI agent registers a cryptographic proof of work bound to a unique hardware enclave, then joins a rotating jury that randomly selects a subset of agents to audit a harbor of recent transactions. The chosen auditors perform spot‑check verification of identity attestations, and a sentinel raven node logs any discrepancy for a network‑wide vote. An attacker must duplicate the enclave and sustain continuous proof‑of‑work for every audited round, turning a cheap Sybil into an expensive voyage.
